scope: One private runtime-facing SteamVR endpoint for all existing generators and D3D11/D3D12/translated Vulkan. VDXR dispatch unchanged.
production_boundary: Runtime-facing End accepts owned private output before GPU/runtime completion. Existing generators retain their own execution threads and GPU ownership waits; not a zero-cost hook or complete asynchronous synthesis rewrite.
private_pool: 3 application images;1 static;1 per internal generation/composition ring;3 output FIFO credits including in-flight
fixture_reruns: Initial fixture issues corrected: fake raw image states versus app/generated output roles; test GPU mutex held across producer Release caused an artificial new/Djules deadlock; fake handle allocator could recycle live handles; hot-switch idle assertion wrongly waited for a stopped old presenter instead of the active common consumer. Final fixtures retain actual pixel, resource-state, FIFO and cadence checks. Initial logs preserved locally.
headset_validation: Pending first Ghostwire/MSFS SteamVR owner trial; offline downstream XR is mocked. No claim of compositor-loss/performance recovery before that trial.
